prompt: Write 10 distinct lessons the mortgage-underwriting agent (residential mortgage applications and remortgages) at Larkmere Mutual learned across many cases about: falling behind on mortgage payments. Return {"items": [{"type": "fact" | "preference" | "observation", "content": "..."}]} with exactly 10 items. (batch 0)
